question: For each academic year and department name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 5, list the academic year, the description of the academic year, the department name, the variance of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that match that academic year and have a term status indicator of 'P', the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum start date of the academic term, and calculate the variance of total units per subject (variance divided by subject count) rounded to two decimal places, ordered by the variance per subject in descending order.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  at.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
  at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
  ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  VARIANCE(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subjects_count,
  MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date,
  ROUND(VARIANCE(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) / COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_ID), 2) AS variance_per_subject
FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at
JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs
  ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
WHERE at.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P'
GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME
HAVING COUNT(ccs.SUBJECT_ID) > 5
ORDER BY variance_per_subject DESC

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'), cte_subject_units AS (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 9999 ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS academic_year_desc FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP), SubjectUnitsStats AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY year_sort, academic_year, dept_sort) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, academic_year_desc, dept, units_range, units_variance FROM cte_subject_units AS tbl ORDER BY year_sort, dept_sort), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10), BuildingRoomStats AS (SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON ic.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY ic.area_range DESC) SELECT s.academic_year, s.academic_year_desc, s.dept, s.units_range, s.units_variance, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.area_range, b.area_variance, b.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT FROM SubjectUnitsStats AS s CROSS JOIN BuildingRoomStats AS b ORDER BY s.academic_year, s.dept, b.area_range DESC

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME), subquery1 AS (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.record_count_variance, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, t2.Subject_Count FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 1) AS t1 JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS t2 ON t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND t2.rn = 1 ORDER BY t1.record_count_variance DESC), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), subquery2 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, material_count, min_term_code FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS material_count, MIN(TERM_CODE) AS min_term_code FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code), CombinedResults AS (SELECT 'Highest Variance Year' AS Result_Type, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.record_count_variance, s1.Most_Represented_Department, s1.Subject_Count, NULL AS TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS material_count, NULL AS min_term_code FROM subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT 'Textbook Materials' AS Result_Type, s2.academic_year, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS record_count_variance, NULL AS Most_Represented_Department, NULL AS Subject_Count, s2.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.material_count, s2.min_term_code FROM subquery2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY Result_Type, academic_year, min_term_code

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE (lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = 928034000 OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')), dept_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_grad_subjects, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, icte.TIP_TERM_CODE, icte.LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, icte.TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, icte.MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.enrolled_range, ds.enrolled_variance, ds.num_grad_subjects FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN VARIANCE(LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(stddev_total_units) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), DepartmentsWithHighVariance AS (SELECT DISTINCT dept FROM Subquery1 WHERE NOT catalog_key_variance IS NULL) SELECT s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH StudentInfo AS (SELECT sd.DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK AS department_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, msd.FULL_NAME AS student_full_name, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS student_email_address, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE) AS school_code_dense_rank, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), DepartmentCIPStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), CombinedResults AS (SELECT si.department_name, si.department_full_name, si.student_full_name, si.student_email_address, si.school_code_dense_rank, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance FROM StudentInfo AS si LEFT JOIN DepartmentCIPStats AS dcs ON si.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS department_name, dcs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, NULL AS student_full_name, NULL AS student_email_address, NULL AS school_code_dense_rank, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance FROM DepartmentCIPStats AS dcs WHERE NOT dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM StudentInfo)) SELECT department_name, department_full_name, student_full_name, student_email_address, school_code_dense_rank, cip_code_range, cip_code_variance FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY department_full_name, student_full_name

WITH inner_cte1 AS (WITH student_counts AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.STUDENT_YEAR, sc.num_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN student_counts AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17'), dept_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT STUDENT_YEAR) AS num_student_years, AVG(num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(num_students) - MIN(num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), subq1 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.num_student_years, ic.STUDENT_YEAR, ic.num_students, ds.avg_students_per_year, ds.range_students_per_year, ds.var_students_per_year, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_dept, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID), subq2 AS (SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.subject_rank_in_dept, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID LIMIT 10), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.num_student_years, s1.STUDENT_YEAR, s1.num_students, s1.avg_students_per_year, s1.range_students_per_year, s1.var_students_per_year, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS subject_rank_in_dept, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM subq1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS num_student_years, NULL AS STUDENT_YEAR, NULL AS num_students, NULL AS avg_students_per_year, NULL AS range_students_per_year, NULL AS var_students_per_year, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.subject_rank_in_dept, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM subq2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, STUDENT_YEAR

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS term_description, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS subject_count_in_dept FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.TERM_CODE, SELECT 'Subject_Details' AS result_type, NULL AS academic_year, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS var_total_units, s2.term_description, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.subject_rank_in_dept, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.subject_count_in_dept FROM Subquery2 AS s2 ORDER BY result_type, academic_year, department_name, term_description, subject_code

WITH SponsorStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE, AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS avg_max_enrollment, VARIANCE(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS var_max_enrollment FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS d JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE NOT d.MAX_ENROLLMENT IS NULL GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.SPONSOR_TYPE) SELECT icte.SPONSOR_NAME, icte.SPONSOR_TYPE, icte.avg_max_enrollment, icte.var_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS icte ORDER BY icte.avg_max_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5), DeptMaxEnroll AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS math_iap_activities_2021 FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS isd JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment, isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY FROM `IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL` AS isd JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, isd.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY) SELECT ss.SPONSOR_NAME, ss.SPONSOR_TYPE, ss.avg_max_enrollment, ss.var_max_enrollment, dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dme.highest_max_enrollment FROM SponsorStats AS ss JOIN `IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR` AS s ON ss.SPONSOR_NAME = s.SPONSOR_NAME AND ss.SPONSOR_TYPE = s.SPONSOR_TYPE JOIN DeptMaxEnroll AS dme ON s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = dme.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY

projection_contract.role: aggregation role: academic year, the description of the academic year, the department name, the variance of the total units for all subjects offered in terms that match that academic year and have a term status indicator of 'P', the number of unique subjects offered, the minimum start date of the academic term, and calculate the variance of total units per subject (variance divided
aggregation role: subject count) rounded to two decimal places, ordered by the variance per subject in descending order

predicate_contract.role: filter role: each academic year and department name where the number of enrolled students is greater than 5

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y'), cte_subject_units AS (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 9999 ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS dept_sort, ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance, MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS academic_year_desc FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP), SubjectUnitsStats AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY year_sort, academic_year, dept_sort) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, academic_year_desc, dept, units_range, units_variance FROM cte_subject_units AS tbl ORDER BY year_sort, dept_sort), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, MAX(r.AREA) - MIN(r.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE b.SITE = 'MIT' AND b.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY b.BUILDING_NAME HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 10), BuildingRoomStats AS (SELECT ic.BUILDING_NAME, ic.area_range, ic.area_variance, ic.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS b ON ic.BUILDING_NAME = b.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY ic.area_range DESC) SELECT s.academic_year, s.academic_year_desc, s.dept, s.units_range, s.units_variance, b.BUILDING_NAME, b.area_range, b.area_variance, b.area_stddev, b.ASSIGNABLE_AREA, b.DATE_BUILT FROM SubjectUnitsStats AS s CROSS JOIN BuildingRoomStats AS b ORDER BY s.academic_year, s.dept, b.area_range DESC

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT) AS record_count_variance FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_DETAIL.RECORD_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME), subquery1 AS (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t1.record_count_variance, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Represented_Department, t2.Subject_Count FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(record_count_variance) AS record_count_variance FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY record_count_variance DESC LIMIT 1) AS t1 JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS t2 ON t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND t2.rn = 1 ORDER BY t1.record_count_variance DESC), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS t0 JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), subquery2 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(academic_year) OVER (ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code) = academic_year THEN NULL ELSE academic_year END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, material_count, min_term_code FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACADEMIC_YEAR) = 0 AND GROUPING(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE ACADEMIC_YEAR END AS academic_year, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS material_count, MIN(TERM_CODE) AS min_term_code FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY academic_year_sort, min_term_code), CombinedResults AS (SELECT 'Highest Variance Year' AS Result_Type, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.record_count_variance, s1.Most_Represented_Department, s1.Subject_Count, NULL AS TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS material_count, NULL AS min_term_code FROM subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT 'Textbook Materials' AS Result_Type, s2.academic_year, NULL AS ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS record_count_variance, NULL AS Most_Represented_Department, NULL AS Subject_Count, s2.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.material_count, s2.min_term_code FROM subquery2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY Result_Type, academic_year, min_term_code

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE AS LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, tso.TERM_CODE AS TIP_TERM_CODE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID) AS MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON lso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = tso.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID WHERE (lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = 928034000 OR tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')), dept_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_grad_subjects, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.LIBRARY_TERM_CODE, icte.TIP_TERM_CODE, icte.LIBRARY_NUM_ENROLLED, icte.TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, icte.MIN_TIP_NUM_ENROLLED, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.enrolled_range, ds.enrolled_variance, ds.num_grad_subjects FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, catalog_key_variance, term_sort FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT AS dept, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') AS base GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(stddev_total_units) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), DepartmentsWithHighVariance AS (SELECT DISTINCT dept FROM Subquery1 WHERE NOT catalog_key_variance IS NULL) SELECT s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM Subquery2 AS s2 WHERE s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN (SELECT dept FROM DepartmentsWithHighVariance) ORDER BY s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH StudentInfo AS (SELECT sd.DEPT_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK AS department_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, msd.FULL_NAME AS student_full_name, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS AS student_email_address, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE) AS school_code_dense_rank, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), DepartmentCIPStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) - MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_range, VARIANCE(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS cip_code_variance FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE IS NULL AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), CombinedResults AS (SELECT si.department_name, si.department_full_name, si.student_full_name, si.student_email_address, si.school_code_dense_rank, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance FROM StudentInfo AS si LEFT JOIN DepartmentCIPStats AS dcs ON si.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS department_name, dcs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name, NULL AS student_full_name, NULL AS student_email_address, NULL AS school_code_dense_rank, dcs.cip_code_range, dcs.cip_code_variance FROM DepartmentCIPStats AS dcs WHERE NOT dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM StudentInfo)) SELECT department_name, department_full_name, student_full_name, student_email_address, school_code_dense_rank, cip_code_range, cip_code_variance FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY department_full_name, student_full_name

WITH inner_cte1 AS (WITH student_counts AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.STUDENT_YEAR, sc.num_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN student_counts AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17'), dept_stats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT STUDENT_YEAR) AS num_student_years, AVG(num_students) AS avg_students_per_year, MAX(num_students) - MIN(num_students) AS range_students_per_year, VARIANCE(num_students) AS var_students_per_year FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), subq1 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.num_student_years, ic.STUDENT_YEAR, ic.num_students, ds.avg_students_per_year, ds.range_students_per_year, ds.var_students_per_year, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN dept_stats AS ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_dept, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID), subq2 AS (SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.subject_rank_in_dept, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID AND ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID LIMIT 10), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.num_student_years, s1.STUDENT_YEAR, s1.num_students, s1.avg_students_per_year, s1.range_students_per_year, s1.var_students_per_year, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS subject_rank_in_dept, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM subq1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS num_student_years, NULL AS STUDENT_YEAR, NULL AS num_students, NULL AS avg_students_per_year, NULL AS range_students_per_year, NULL AS var_students_per_year, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.subject_rank_in_dept, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM subq2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, STUDENT_YEAR

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Mathematics%') SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS term_description, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_stats.subject_count_in_dept, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count_in_dept FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_stats ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = dept_stats.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT 'Department_Statistics' AS result_type, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units, s1.var_total_units, NULL AS term_description, NULL AS subject_code, NULL AS subject_number, NULL AS subject_title, NULL AS subject_rank_in_dept, NULL AS school_name, NULL AS subject_count_in_dept FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL
